title: Project nested creature trait/action mechanics beyond basic attacks
description:
Finding sources:
- ChatGPT found roughly 110 creature records with mechanical traits/actions still prose-only.
- Examples included Magic Resistance, Innate Spellcasting, Legendary Resistance, Spellcasting, Regeneration, Healing Touch, triggered traits, bat Bite, and lamia Intoxicating Touch.
- Fable verified all creature text and numeric values are accurate, so the issue is modeling/projection rather than dropped creature source text.

Acceptance criteria:
- Inventory all creature traits/actions/reactions/legendaryActions with gameplay effects not represented in typed mechanics.
- Add typed projections by bounded category; split child beads if the inventory is large.
- At minimum cover resistance/advantage traits, spellcasting/innate spellcasting metadata, regeneration/healing, condition-inflicting actions, save DC effects, recharge/limited-use effects, and triggered traits.
- Readiness reporting must distinguish modeled nested mechanics from prose-only or intentionally unsupported mechanics.
close_reason: Implemented in PR #396: typed nested creature-entry mechanics (usage economies, modifier/regeneration/multiattack/healing/immunity/trigger grammars, structured fail-closed spellcasting projections), wrapped-spell-list trait-split fix (night-hag/oni/unicorn), ledger emission-index mechanics exclusion, nested readiness dispositions; 317/317 creatures and 1270/1480 entries typed
